svg.title: The seal
svg.desc: A round seal. Eight points on a circle are numbered in beads, one to eight, in the profile's own numerals. A star joins them in counting order: every step is three eighths of a turn, and the eighth step is home. From each point one arm spirals in to the centre and its mirror spirals out, crossing on the eight rays at radii 1 over root 2, 1 over 3, 1 over 5 root 2, 1 over 17. A spark walks the star, and beads of light ride the arms in step with it.
